sources.title: Ebben WP et al. Kinetic analysis of several variations of push-ups. J Strength Cond Res 2011;25(10):2891-2894
sources.secondary_source_for_box_heights: Contreras B et al. The biomechanics of the push-up. Strength Cond J 2012 (summarises Ebben 2011 values by box height)

field_notes.fedb_id: Every value was checked programmatically against the snapshot above; all exist.
field_notes.mechanic: Copied from free-exercise-db; for timed holds with no value in the dataset it is null.
field_notes.aliases: Author judgement of Indian gym usage and common misspellings. Not from a published source.
field_notes.popularity: Author judgement (very common / common / occasional). Not from a published source.
field_notes.group/sub_group: Assigned for Indian gym use; where this differs from free-exercise-db primaryMuscles the notes field says so.
field_notes.bodyweight_fraction: Only filled where a measured value was found (peak vertical ground reaction force as a share of body mass). null everywhere else.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Fraction = peak vertical GRF as share of body mass (Ebben 2011), regular push-up. Traditional 'dand' (Hindu push-up) is a flowing variant; no measured fraction found for it.

exercises.name: Decline Push-Up (feet elevated)
exercises.notes: 0.70 with feet on a 30.5 cm box; 0.74 with feet on a 61 cm box (Ebben 2011).

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up (hands elevated)
exercises.notes: 0.55 with hands on a 30.5 cm box; 0.41 with hands on a 61 cm box (Ebben 2011).

exercises.name: Wide Push-Up
exercises.notes: No specific fraction for wide hand placement; Ebben 2011 cites a 52.9-72.9% range across hand positions from an earlier study, not a single value.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.notes: No published fraction of body mass lifted found; left null.

exercises.notes: Bodyweight plus an external load entered separately.

activities.name: Treadmill walk
activities.notes: Compendium treadmill-walking codes are all 0% grade and use mph bands (1 mph = 1.609344 km/h). For incline > 0 use the ACSM walking equation instead.

activities.name: Incline treadmill walk
activities.notes: No Compendium 2024 code for unloaded incline treadmill walking by speed and grade. Codes listed are outdoor hill climbing by grade band (fallback only). Prefer the ACSM walking equation.

activities.name: Treadmill run
activities.notes: 12255/12260/12265 are measured uphill runs at 5% incline; 12325 is 15% incline.

activities.name: Stationary cycle
activities.notes: Use watts codes when the bike shows watts; 01200 when it does not. ACSM cycling constant could not be sourced (see burn-model gaps).

activities.name: Elliptical / cross trainer
activities.notes: Only moderate and vigorous effort codes exist.

activities.name: Stair climber
activities.notes: 02065 is the stair treadmill ergometer (general). 17131/17133/17134 are real stair climbing by pace; use as effort levels only if the user climbs actual stairs.

activities.name: Walking (outdoor)
activities.notes: Level, firm surface codes by speed band.

activities.name: Cricket
activities.notes: Single code covers batting, bowling and fielding.

activities.name: Badminton
activities.notes: Social vs competitive vs match play.

activities.name: Surya namaskar
activities.notes: Code is per minute; rounds-to-minutes conversion is not in the Compendium.

missing.name: Assisted Pull-Up / Dip Machine
missing.description: Counterweighted machine that reduces the body mass lifted in pull-ups and dips.
missing.why_needed: Standard in Indian commercial gyms; load_type 'assisted' (body mass minus counterweight).

missing.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
missing.description: Split squat with the rear foot elevated on a bench.
missing.why_needed: Very common leg exercise; free-exercise-db only has the floor split squat.

missing.name: Knee Push-Up
missing.why_needed: Common beginner/home variant. A sourced bodyweight fraction exists: 0.49 (Ebben 2011).

missing.name: Burpee
missing.description: Squat thrust with push-up and jump.
missing.why_needed: Very common at home and in HIIT; Compendium 02214/02020 mention burpees but the exercise has no free-exercise-db id.

missing.name: Jumping Jacks
missing.why_needed: Common warm-up; Compendium 02020 mentions jumping jacks.

missing.name: Wall Sit
missing.description: Isometric squat hold against a wall (timed).

missing.name: Hip Thrust Machine
missing.description: Plate-loaded or selectorised hip thrust machine.
missing.why_needed: Increasingly common; barbell version exists in dataset.

missing.name: Lateral Band Walk
missing.description: Side steps with a mini band around the legs.

missing.name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
missing.description: Standing calf raise with no added load.
missing.why_needed: Very common at home; dataset versions all use equipment.

missing.name: Hindu Squat / Hindu Push-Up (baithak / dand)
missing.description: Traditional Indian akhada variants of the squat and push-up.
missing.why_needed: Cultural relevance; currently aliased to the closest standard exercises. No measured energy cost or bodyweight fraction found.
